contamination_governance_mandate.core_truth: The entire multi-year dataset spanning 2022-01-01 to 2026-09-30 is historical data. Every month has been downloaded, validated, and subjected to prior retrospective analysis. Under scientific empirical standards, NO historical partition can be described as virgin, prospective, or independent out-of-sample.
contamination_governance_mandate.walk_forward_evaluation_rule: Evaluations on historical data must use strict chronological expanding-window walk-forward protocols (train strictly on [t_0, t_k) and evaluate on [t_k, t_k+h)). However, all results must be reported as historical research evidence, NOT prospective validation.
contamination_governance_mandate.true_out_of_sample_requirement: True independent out-of-sample evidence can ONLY be gathered on future live market data generated AFTER all feature definitions, similarity metrics, and prediction rules are completely frozen and locked without operator intervention.
